title: A second "none of these" is decided from the owner's notes, not asked again
why: Item 606 was asked three times (606, 701, 703) on Nov 13; each time the owner answered "none of these" with a question pointing the same way. At 11:13 CST he wrote "i thought i literally sent questions about this one already ?". Triage made the re-asks (11:03 to 11:12 CST).
note: The page writer refuses a new item that replaces an item already answered "none of these" twice in the same chain (a replaces/ref link to an earlier item). Instead the writer takes the pick the owner's notes point to, if it can be undone, and closes the chain naming the undo; else it asks once in the comment thread, not as a new item. Red case: the 606/701/703 chain. Express (ruling drain-first-hold part 4: tracks owner work). Home: skill waiting-page.
